overloads.semanticRole: Breaks down the current database structure into text/picture files under folderPath (for source control), optionally filtered by category via options, and returns a status/messages report.

constraints: Only usable from 4D in local mode or 4D Server (errors if called from 4D in remote mode) and only against an interpreted database (does nothing if called from a compiled .4DC database).
When called from a component, always exports the host database's structure, not the component's.
options.filter, if present, switches to an explicit opt-in model: every export category (projectMethods, forms, catalog, etc.) defaults to false and must be individually set to true to be included.
The 'trash' filter only has an effect if 'projectMethods' or 'forms' is also selected.
The returned object's 'success' is false only if any message in 'messages' has severity 'error'.
